title: The variance of the Pitman--Yor process: Cifarelli--Regazzini-type identities and inversion formulas
summary: The Cifarelli--Regazzini identity lies at the foundation of the theory of the Dirichlet process and has played a central role in Bayesian nonparametric statistics. By providing the generalized Cauchy--Stieltjes transform of linear functionals of the Dirichlet process, together with an analytic inversion, it yields explicit representations for the distribution function and density of the Dirichlet mean.
